title: ペア行動禁止違反の成立通知
editionScope: First identified candidate of this independent gallery series. Existing game notifications and history retained.

productionMeaning.meaning: A qualifying player receives pair-route-violation at their own position after a sustained shared route, grace and cooldown. Defense or overheal can absorb damage. The authored sign denotes the violation receipt and has no knowledge of a damage result.
productionMeaning.scope: The local fixture exposes only an explicitly confirmed, displayable and current self receipt. Other-player, unconfirmed, private, stale and repeated receipts cannot start the effect. The two bands are a single sign, not partner positions or a map route. Game-side observation and serialization are separate.

design.primary: Two short parallel brass strips travel along the same axis above a neutral self marker. Their leading edges meet one rising vermilion slash at 245 ms. The slash outlasts the strips and clears by 920 ms. The quiet owner bust remains.
design.spatial: One self projection in reference CSS pixels. The independent fixture does not query a world, neighbors, motion vector, partner count, role, injury or damage.
design.time: 940 ms local one-shot; rise, closure, held stop, lanes fade then slash fade. Reduced motion decreases lane travel from 18 to 3 reference units.
design.light: Short warm localized response at closure, with restrained local spill and final linear-to-display transfer. No full-screen pulse.
design.sound: Soft rising guide tone, then one short damped two-partial contact cue starting at 245 ms. Verify forces mute. No pain sound.
design.provenance: New sign geometry, motion, color and sound. Reused the public missile R1 manual host for technical WebGPU, lifecycle, sizing and audio-gesture handling.

validation.sourceClosure: Read back all four runtime files by immutable commit and compared both text and Git blob hashes. HTML loads one module, it imports violation.mjs and fetches effect.wgsl.
validation.shader: Standalone Naga validation through naga-wasi-cli@0.1.0 succeeded. No native GPU or browser acceptance implied.
validation.logic: Executed receipt acceptance, duplicate and stale/foreign/private/unconfirmed/invalid cause gating. Denied projections use throwing position getters. Missing, sparse, invalid and out-of-range anchor tests passed.
validation.pcm: 8, 44.1, 48, and 96 kHz finite samples, distinct contact peak above guide, zero suffix after 720 ms.
validation.host: JavaScript body syntax checked; actual browser GPU compilation/playback and natural-size quality pending.
unreviewed: ordinary SFX listening and perceived synchronization
